Hi Timotei,

Thank you for your patience, and for sticking with us through two pre-orders.

Here is exactly where both stand. Shop···· (B30 plus Power Kit) and Shop···· (Magic (address hidden), Miner Duster, Power Kit) are both paid and neither has shipped. Both are sitting at our Chattanooga warehouse waiting on the units themselves to be checked in. The dates on your orders were October 15 for the B30 and October 31 for the 40T, and neither batch has landed on the shelf yet, so I am not going to give you a date I cannot stand behind. A colleague is confirming the new dates for both and will come back to you by email on Monday. You can also follow the shipments on their way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

For the wait, I have made you a code for your next order, HD-••••••, $50 off, yours alone, valid on orders over $200.

On the Harlo H15: honestly, I would not add a third pre-order while these two are still open. The H15 is $799 and the current orders are going out by November 30, and the code will still be there if you want it later.

Sorry again for the wait on both.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
